title: Midterm Predictions days before Election Day - 6abc Philadelphia

Midterm Predictions days before Election Day - 6abc Philadelphia 
 24/7 Live Philadelphia Pennsylvania New Jersey Delaware POLITICS 
 Midterm Predictions days before Election Day 
 By Matt O'Donnell , Niki Hawkins Friday, October 30, 2026 11:32PM Share Follow 6abc on Google The predictions are coming fast and furious about what will take place on Election Day - Tuesday, November 3rd and both Democrats and Republicans are 'digging in'! Will there be a 'blue wave' .. or will conservatives keep control? Get the Inside Story with Nia Meeks, Guy Ciarrocchi, Liz Preate Havey and Mark Segal . But first - Host Matt O'Donnell interviews the Executive Editor of Tangle News - Isaac Saul - A Bucks County native that started an un-biased, straight-down-the-middle political website and podcast - to discuss his take on the midterms 2026!
